description: Explicit facts transcribed from the original papers, with false-premise checks. No model-generated reference answers.

cases.question: From the paper: How many layers are in each base encoder/decoder stack? What is the base model dimension? Does scaled dot-product attention divide its logits by d_k, sqrt(d_k), or neither? Does the core Transformer use recurrent layers? What WMT 2014 English-to-German BLEU did the big Transformer report in Table 2? Explain why attention scaling matters in four short sentences.

From this paper: how many diffusion steps T are used in the experiments? Does this original paper use a pretrained image autoencoder for latent-space diffusion? What is its reported CIFAR10 FID for the unconditional model in Table 1? Does the simplified training objective predict added noise? Is the neural network based on U-Net? Explain the forward and reverse processes in four short sentences.

From this paper: are pretrained weight matrices frozen during LoRA training? Does LoRA represent weight updates using a low-rank product? Must the base weight matrix itself be low rank? Does LoRA add inference latency after merging its update? In the GPT-3 175B comparison against full fine-tuning with Adam, by what factors do trainable parameters and GPU memory decrease? Explain the idea in four short sentences with everyday words.
